[[Providence Park|Civic Stadium]] }} {{1972 Pacific-8 Conference football standings}} The '''1972 Oregon State Beavers football team''' represented [[Oregon State University]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference|Pacific-8 Conference]] (Pac-8) during the [[1972 NCAA University Division football season]]. In their eighth season under head coach [[Dee Andros]], the Beavers compiled an overall record of 2–9 record with a mark of 1–6 in conference play, placing last out of eight teams in the Pac-8, and were outscored 295 to 131.{{cite web|title=1972 Oregon State Beavers Schedule and Results|publisher=Sports Reference LLC|work=SR/College Football|access-date=September 7, 2016|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cfb/schools/oregon-state/1972-schedule.html}} Oregon State played four home games on campus at [[Reser Stadium|Parker Stadium]] in [[Corvallis, Oregon|Corvallis]] and one at [[Providence Park|Civic Stadium]] in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]]. The loss to rival [[1972 Oregon Ducks football team|Oregon]] was Andros' first setback in the [[Oregon–Oregon State football rivalry|Civil War]] game, and the Ducks' first win over the Beavers in nine
